arStrings.szText: Continue the fight and the search for answers
Look for Tyrael in Gea Kul
Gather intelligence from the Úllo Sar: 0/3
Gather intelligence from the Úllo Sar: 1/3
Gather intelligence from the Úllo Sar: 2/3

The Úllo Sar are about to do something drastic. The Nameless' last message spoke of "opening the artery" to Pandemonium. Whatever Tyrael has been doing since he left, I hope he's found something useful and returned to Gea Kul. We'll make sense of this together. We have to.
Tyrael hasn't returned to Gea Kul, but there's a message in his place. I almost dread to open it.

When I asked Tyrael about this nameless man, he would not answer me. "Sworn to secrecy," he said, before he left to do...who knows what? Since I met him, Tyrael has been steady as a guiding star, but today, I saw horror in his face. I need answers. I need to keep fighting. I don't know what else I can do.
